title: Studio Chromato, Studio Colorido, Shingo Yamashita Produce New Pokémon Short About Wartortle
content: The Pokémon Company began streaming a new " POKÉTOON " anime short on Wednesday. The short is titled "Kameil to Natsu no Tsuzuku" (Wartortle and the Ongoing Summer). The short follows a boy named Rikuto who visits his grandmother on an island at the end of summer. There, he meets a Wartortle.
author: ANN

title: ReZero’s Studio Has a New Isekai Anime Coming This Fall – Watch the Trailer
content: Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- has been in the midst of its biggest season of the anime to date this year, and the studio behind it has revealed they have a new Isekai anime franchise kicking off its own run later this Fall.

title: 'Cheat Fuyo' Reveals Additional Staff, Second Teaser Promo

title: Chainsmoker Cat Anime Casts Yumi Hara
content: The staff for the television anime of Nyan Nyan Factory 's Chainsmoker Cat ( Yanineko ) manga announced on Wednesday that Yumi Hara will join the anime's cast as Yani Neko's mother Shizue Satō. The character will appear in the anime's seventh episode on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: New Pokémon Short Anime Directed by Shingo Yamashita Released
content: A new POKÉTOON short anime titled Wartortle and the Continuation of Summer premiered on the official Pokémon YouTube channel on August 12. Shingo Yamashita directed the short, with animation production by Studio Chromato and Studio Colorido.
author: Anime Corner
